MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink butt connectors feel like a natural addition to my spade connector assortment because they serve a related wire-repair need while adding a sealed connection.",
    "The J-B Weld epoxy fits my interest in practical repair adhesives, although I would wait until I had a specific rigid repair before buying that size."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The cutting wheels and bristle disc assume a metalworking or surface-cleaning task and compatible tools that my purchases do not establish.",
    "The six sealant cartridges and 36 rolls of painters tape require specific projects and quantities I do not currently need; using repair tape does not mean I am preparing to paint or seal extensively.",
    "The deck screws, magnets, and steel wool lack a clear connection to a repair I currently want to make."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My clamps, connectors, and adhesives seem to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop supply, even though each purchase addressed a particular practical need.",
    "Shared brands or words such as tape and repair seem to carry too much weight when the actual use differs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "A useful next choice needs a concrete purpose, like adding sealed wire splices alongside my existing quick-disconnect terminals.",
    "Quantity and repair material matter: interest in vinyl cement does not establish an immediate need for a large pack of rigid-repair epoxy.",
    "My purchases are spread across years, so an older repair supply does not necessarily describe a project I am doing now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests but too often assume unrelated projects, tools, and bulk supply needs."
}
